technology_name: Powder Jaggery-Based Fortified Cookies and Cakes
institution: ICAR-Sugarcane Breeding Institute Research Centre, Kannur
problem_solved: Dependence on refined sugar in bakery products
description: This technology incorporates powder jaggery into bakery products such as cookies and cakes as an alternative sweetening ingredient. The formulation supports the development of bakery products using sugarcane-derived sweeteners while enhancing the utilization of jaggery in processed foods.
applications:
Bakery and confectionery manufacturing companies
Health food and clean-label food product enterprises
Jaggery processing and sugarcane value-addition industries
Retail food brands and packaged snack manufacturers
Agri-food startups developing natural sweetener-based products
secondary_sector: Consumer & Lifestyle Products, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
